notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve (trial). Small support SaaS focused on SMBs; heavy chat-based workflows for agents (average session 3–6 turns).

Primary ask / pain: intermittent latency spikes for EU-based agents. They see p95 around 800ms–1.4s on some prompts; target is <300ms p95 for short assistant replies. Cost sensitivity: medium (watch token spend).

Symptoms described by customer:
- "Feels fine from US, but EU agents complain about slow replies, sometimes timing out in UI" (quote from Ops lead).
- Spikes correlate with longer prompts and multi-message contexts (system + user + history).
- Using default SDK setup, no explicit region pinned; likely routing to us-east by default from EU clients.

What we've recommended so far (shared in drive/perf-checklist.xlsx):
- Immediate: advise customer to pin region to eu-west1 for EU users to test (reduces cross-region RTT).
- Timeouts: suggest client-side request timeout = 30s for normal generation; UI-level quick-fail at 3–5s for optimistic UX with background retry. Server-side keepalive recommended.
- Prompt length: reduce history sent on first pass (send last 2 turns + embeddings for retrieval). For short replies encourage ~50–150 token prompts; avoid 1.5k+ token system messages when not necessary.
- Streaming: enable streaming responses in UI to show partial tokens and improve perceived latency.
- Caching: enable prefix caching for repeated canned prompts (agent macros).
- Retries: exponential backoff with jitter; avoid tight synchronous retries that amplify spikes.

POC plan proposed: 1) Run 3-region synthetic perf test (us-east, us-west, eu-west) using customer's representative prompt set (~100 requests each) and capture p50/p95/p99 + token counts. 2) Test with prompt-pruning (send last 2 turns only) + streaming enabled. 3) Evaluate cost delta with batch vs single requests.

Security/compliance: They require SSO (SAML) for team access and audit logs. No strict on-prem need today. Data residency preference: EU for EU team but will accept hosted in eu-west.

Customer comments / quotes: "If we can get consistent sub-300ms replies for quick agent assist use cases we're ready to convert. Right now it's flaky."

- Good inbound fit for Hosted API + Optimize recommendations.
- Keep messaging lightweight: emphasize region pinning and prompt guidance as low-effort wins.
- Bring SE to first cross-region test call; collect traces (include X-Request-Id) and HARs.
